Worlds Within a World: Author roundtable

   August 25, 2026
   4.00pm—6.00pm
   Old Midland Courthouse
   Book Here
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:50
Instaread

Join authors Barb Hostalek and Valerie Swift for a conversation about Worlds Within a World, moderated by Nandi Chinna.

This free event takes place on Tuesday 25 August at the Old Midland Courthouse from 4.00–6.00 pm.

In Worlds Within a World, five First Nations women show what it is like to navigate challenges and deprivations while staying connected to Country and the world’s oldest living culture. Through personal stories and reflections, the panel will explore themes of identity, culture, family, resilience and belonging and discuss the experience of contributing to this powerful collection of memoir and life writing.

If you’re interested in First Nations stories, memoir and contemporary Australian writing, this is the perfect event for you.

The event is free to attend, but please book in as spaces are limited: https://events.humanitix.com/authors-roundtable-worlds-within-a-world-at-old-midland-courthouse

For writers

Fremantle Press welcomes unsolicited manuscripts from authors of Western Australian origin or whose main place of residence is Western Australia. Work by non–Western Australian authors will be considered when the subject matter has a strong Western Australian focus. This applies to all genres we publish.
